Excited to get the POC kickoff scheduled. Based on our earlier convo, the working session should cover prompt review, routing profiles, and a short load exercise on the staging cluster so we can validate latency at target QPS. Proposed agenda (60–90m):

- Introductions & goals (10m)

- Routing & model variants discussion (10m)
- Hands-on prompt run-through + KV cache demo (20m)
- Short load test + metrics review (15m)
- Next steps / rollout plan (10m)

1) Do you prefer onsite at your SF office (we can bring a small AV kit) or virtual?
2) If onsite: will we need visitor badges and a host escort? Any sponsor list/name to submit in advance?
3) If virtual: do you want the session recorded and stored in your Drive (we’ll keep recording off by default unless you say ok)?

We have availability next week: Tue 5/5 10:00–12:00 PDT, Wed 5/6 13:00–15:00 PDT, or Thu 5/7 09:00–11:00 PDT. Please pick a slot or suggest alternatives. I’ve attached a draft agenda and a short network checklist for the load test.

Thanks — jasmine
